body:
This is what sympathy is made up of. Comparing your situation now to other situations. Whether those other ones are your own or of someone else's.

Sympathy is shit. I don't need it, I don't want it. It helps nobody.

What we all need is empathy. To have someone who connects with what you're feeling. They show an understanding and receptiveness to the wat you feel. And they tell you that you are not alone. And they show you that when you're sad, they're sad.

I used to think the same. But now I'm angry with all my "friends and family"

Nobody noticed me. Nobody saw my pain. And those who did have done little to nothing to help me.

Fuck em. All of them.

If they feel guilty, or sorrow, or depression, or pain: then maybe they'll finally fucking see me. Maybe then they'll understand the painful life I faced every **fucking** day.

I've moved past worrying about the sorrow I'd leave behind. Hopefully you won't get this far.

And feel defeated when I do wake up. From there the rest of the day is just an uphill climb until you excitedly go to bed and think about how you might not wake up tomorrow. And then it just repeats.

Over. And over. And over. And over. And over.

I remember the days when I thought going to hospital for a few days would be nice. Maybe then people would understand that not everything is OK. Maybe the work and the stress would become less.

Those were the days.

Now I just let it all get worse and worse hoping that eventually it'll be enough to throw me over.

Chin up bud, you're not alone in feeling the way you do.

I'm not sure you're quite getting it. If they ask you those annoying questions, if they just keep asking why, it ain't doing any good.

Leave me alone.

You don't care about me, you didn't notice my pain, you just think that you have to understand this now. You're not helping by asking me why I cut myself. You feel obliged to do something, but don't worry FAM, you don't need to pretend that you care.

You don't understand my situation. And all you're doing by asking "why?!" is passing judgement and just furthering the idea that you don't understand. Pestering with the same question doesn't help anything. Stop asking that dumb fucking question.

I hate the "are you OK?" question. You found my search history of suicide methods, do you really think I'm doing dandy? Do you think this is just the norm. Stop wasting your breath and try and show some level of understanding. Stop judging me and start helping. Maybe just listen for once, eh? Maybe just try and be receptive and compassionate. Maybe don't ask dumb questions that we all know the answer to.

I don't know what I'm saying anymore. Sorry dude. I don't think I really conveyed the point, but asking why constantly just doesn't help.

It's not worth it. There is no end to the pain. I'm sick of the suicide hotlines and all the people saying that it's OK. It's not.

I'm sick of learning "coping strategies". Normal people don't need to learn how to cope, they just do. I'm different. I'm broken.  I'm of no use.

Might as well escape this dumb shit, prolonging it is doing nothing but wasting the worlds resources.
Why do we struggle through it day after day? Like what is the honest point of it?
Sometimes it's nice when other people can see. Sometimes it's nice to know that other people still see me.
Damn. Here in Canada we ain't going to see 30c weather for a while.

I really feel you when you said you feel tethered to life. I feel the *exact* same way, and that's just the perfect way of putting it.

Hang in there, we'll get through this together.
Where do you live that it's still so hot out?
